snippet.title: Super Choppy! WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM!
snippet.description:
Super Choppy is a challenging indie action platformer with beautiful retro pixel art. Play as Choppy and master the platforming gameplay mechanics of using his axe to throw, fly, climb, and chop your way through a silly revenge-fueled adventure.

Go wishlist it now and play the demo when it is released in a few days! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3616860/Super_Choppy/

#steam #indiegame #indiedev #platformer #demo
